basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old architecture enthusiast living in North Dublin. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to pursue my passion for architecture and design. My interests include exploring new design trends, playing chess, and nostalgia trips with Homestar Runner and classic Disney movies. I'm single and often online in the evenings after 7 PM, usually browsing or contributing to discussions related to architecture and design.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design and have developed a keen interest in architecture through online courses and self-study. My love for design extends beyond my profession, regularly researching architectural styles and design principles. I'm also a member of several online design communities where I exchange ideas and learn from peers.
